body: Looks pretty good from my perspective. Needs these property info changes, and a rebase+squash, and approval from physics folks.
Style and documentation look good! Haven't tested the functionality

Tested locally, it works as expected. Code and documentation look good to me.

**Testing project:** [physics_tests.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26291947/physics_tests.zip)
<sub>Use **Functional Tests > Box Pyramid**. To switch between tapered capsules and cylinders, edit the `create_rigidbody_box()` function in `test.gd`.</sub>

In GodotPhysics3D, the behavior seems a little odd, especially with the tapered capsules (which seem to act like standard capsules). Notice on the video where the capsules roll on their side, but the contact point in red is placed on the floor, away from the actual shape. This doesn't happen in Jolt Physics.
